WI1-hatch-finality-law.detail: VisionLoop.runLoop's existing failure -> re-plan gate evaluates the hatch conditions IN ORDER before recordedOpinions: (1) pointer != lastIndex -> `MODELS_CONFIRM_DONE suppressed: subtask <i>/<n> is not final - the hatch never terminates a non-final subtask`; (2) guardStrength(active.done) != WEAK -> `... the final condition is code-verifiable (STRONG) and unmet - the code checker is authoritative`; (3) the ladder carries any AnswerExtracted while answer == null -> `... a report answer is still pending`. A suppressed hatch falls through to the unchanged re-plan budget (REPLANS_EXHAUSTED when spent); the pointer is never advanced by a model-only confirmation. Only when 1-3 pass does recordedOpinions run; only when the pair agrees (noul >= noulAgreeAbove AND confirm true) does the ONE goal-level Jev Noul('goal', goal + final subtask + done condition) run. A null/refused or sub-threshold goal noul records `... the goal-level noul did not agree (goalNoul=<...|null>)`. A successful hatch keeps the existing outcome/evidence/log lines and adds `goal=AGREE(<...>)` to the outcome/log render and `goalNoul=<...>` to the evidence event. All suppression lines also ride outcomes + the corner log (the phase doc's 'evidence' surface).

WI2-product-page-cta-scroll-churn.detail: VisionPrompts v12 -> v13: PROPOSE_SYSTEM adds the product-page CTA law (visible purchase control tapped, sticky/fixed bars included; never scroll while the needed control is visible; one scroll repeated at most 3 times; the <scroll-churn> block is code-generated guidance), PLAN_SYSTEM adds the purchase-subtask law (author around the VISIBLE control, never a scroll; final verifies the cart item + requested quantity), REPLAN_SKILL adds the product-page scroll-streak law; the version doc comment names v13. VisionLoop.Config gains scrollChurnHintAfter=3 / scrollChurnReplanAfter=4 with require(replan >= hint). The class-field consecutiveScrolls increments only at the end of attemptStep for an Attempted.Acted scroll (Attempted.Acted gained the effective action verb; one construction site) and resets on any acted non-scroll, on an observed URL change, in acceptAdvance and on every new plan install (and at run start). New pure PurchaseControl.hasVisible(nodes): clickable, non-browser-chrome nodes whose text/desc/hint contains a CTA phrase as a normalized token run (add to cart/basket/bag, lisää ostoskoriin/koriin, ostoskoriin, in den warenkorb, ajouter au panier, añadir al carrito, lägg i varukorgen, buy now); boolean only, never clicks. At consecutiveScrolls >= 3 the attempt block builds a VisionPrompts.ScrollChurn(count, stepPurchaseControlVisible), emits ONE `scroll churn: <n> consecutive scrolls on this page[ with a visible purchase control]` marker per episode, and passes it to proposeUser, which renders a <scroll-churn> block naming the count and (when detected) the visible control — no page label injected. At >= 4 AND a detected CTA (and no battery escalation, failure counter below threshold) the attempt is skipped: `step N: SCROLL CHURN - <n> consecutive scrolls with a visible purchase control - forcing a re-plan`, consecutiveFailures = stepFailuresBeforeReplan, step += 1, then the existing re-plan gate/budget runs. Never a forced click; without a CTA only the soft hint fires. The re-plan failure context carries VisionPrompts.JevEvidence.scrollChurn via currentEvidence/failureContext, rendering `scroll churn: <n> consecutive scrolls on this page with no progress` plus `visible purchase control: YES (accessibility tree) - TAP it; do not scroll again` when true; the repair call explicitly copies scrollChurn = null. The stuck detector and every VEXP5 capture/covered-point path are unchanged.

WI3-tests-and-docs.detail: NEW VisionLoopEscapeHatchTest (5, real loop, scripted transports, text-only capture, temp-dir evidence): (1) the run-11 4-subtask regression — first subtask WEAK and already holding (weak-at-start), empty proposals, confirm/noul scripted but never called, maxReplans 0 -> REPLANS_EXHAUSTED + the exact not-final suppression + chat=2 / jev=0; (2) final WEAK + pair 0.96 + goal 0.92 -> MODELS_CONFIRM_DONE, exactly one goal noul, goal=AGREE(0.92)/goalNoul=0.92; (3) goal 0.40 -> the goal-disagree suppression + REPLANS_EXHAUSTED; (4) STRONG urlHost unmet -> the STRONG suppression with chat=2 / jev=0; (5) a refused goal noul (transport failure, maxRetries 0) -> goalNoul=null suppression. NEW PurchaseControlTest (5): clickable Lisää ostoskoriin matches; non-clickable does not; browser chrome does not; Add a note/Edit cart/unrelated do not; the sticky bottom bar is found among other nodes. NEW VisionLoopScrollChurnTest (5, real loop, scripted chat, fabricated capture, distinct observation lines): 3 scrolls -> the 4th proposer body carries <scroll-churn> + ONE marker; 4 scrolls + CTA -> the exact SCROLL CHURN line, no fifth scroll, the re-plan request body carries both churn lines (checked via the raw call-NNN-replan.req.json); an acted non-scroll resets; a URL change resets; no CTA -> the soft hint only. deviations: The hatch suppression lines ride outcomes + the corner log + events.log; the phase doc says 'evidence', and outcomes is the run result's monitoring surface (the same pattern as BATTERY ESCALATE).

The <scroll-churn> proposer block rides every proposer call while consecutiveScrolls stays at/above the hint threshold (the first such call is 'the next proposer call' the doc names); the evidence marker still fires exactly once per churn episode (churnHintLogged, reset with the counter).

The churn hard stop pre-empts only a PROPOSE attempt (escalateCause == null and consecutiveFailures < stepFailuresBeforeReplan); a battery escalation already queued keeps its own re-plan path instead of being double-triggered.
consecutiveScrolls counts an Attempted.Acted scroll even when the executor's boolean is false (the doc's 'only ACTED scroll proposals'); a Failed propose/ground/refusal never touches the counter.

The goal-level noul is a TEXT-ONLY Jev request (the pair already carries the image channel) whose proposition names the goal, the final subtask and its done-condition; null (a refused channel) never passes and renders goalNoul=null.

The finality check is guardStrength != WEAK rather than an explicit 'satisfied' test: reaching the hatch means the code condition was not accepted, so the 'STRONG and unmet' evidence wording is truthful by construction.
